metadata.description: Witloop: an opinionated suite of engineering and automation plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, Grok Build, and Cursor. Host behavior is a capability table; Cursor keep-alive is model-judged /goal.

plugins.name: wit
plugins.description: Witloop: opinionated spec-driven loop for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, Grok Build, and Cursor. /wit:setup is first-run (repo docs, constitution, models, ledger; --auto writes simple plus ledger on); /wit:scan refreshes the map (--refresh; missing repo-map runs setup first); /wit:dev routes feature | bug-fix | investigation (--kind) then brainstorms, designs at one gate (--auto), and implements to a PR with keep-alive (Claude/Codex predicate /goal; Grok and Cursor model-judged /goal; Copilot relaunch); /wit:add-issues files GitHub issues; /wit:rpa builds UiPath from a PDD. Parallel worktrees, ADR log, token report. Soft-integrates superpowers and frontend-design.
